info.name: Get short-lived download URLs for an SDK version and its models

params.name: id
params.description: The unique version ID of the SDK, found in the SDK Dashboard.

items.docs: Retrieves temporary download URLs for a specific licensed SDK version and its associated model files, for use in CI/CD pipelines, automated testing workflows, or custom deployment scripts. The returned S3 URLs expire after data.expires_in seconds.
